name: note_tcomp_1
note:
SKILL GUIDE (pick, place, appliance):
1) After EVERY navigate_to call, call get_observation() again and recompute all poses. The base frame moved; never reuse pixels/depth from before navigation.
2) Pixel -> base/world frame:
   K=obs["robot0_robotview"]["intrinsics"]; P=obs["robot0_robotview"]["pose_mat"]; d=depth[v,u]
   If d<=0.05 or d>3 the pixel is invalid: use a nearby pixel or a different query.
   xc=(u-K[0,2])*d/K[0,0]; yc=(v-K[1,2])*d/K[1,1]; zc=d
   world = (P @ [xc,yc,zc,1.0])[:3]
3) GRASP object: navigate_to the surface it rests on; obs. mask=segment_sam3_point_prompt(rgb, point) or segment_sam3_text_prompt(rgb, name). G,_=plan_grasp(depth,K,mask). If G has rows: pick best, W=(P @ G); t=W[:3,3]; R=W[:3,:3]; quat=wxyz from R. Lift-then-grasp: solve_ik(t+[0,0,0.08],[0,0,1,0]) move; solve_ik(t,[0,0,1,0]) move; open_gripper(); descend solve_ik(t,[0,0,1,0]) move; close_gripper(); lift solve_ik(t+[0,0,0.10],[0,0,1,0]) move.
   If plan_grasp empty: u,v=point_prompt_molmo(rgb,name); world w; open_gripper(); solve_ik(w+[0,0,0.05],[0,0,1,0]) move; close_gripper(); lift [0,0,0.10].
4) PLACE object: navigate_to the fixture holding the target spot; obs; find a pixel on the target surface (e.g. "stove top","burner","dining counter near the tray","sink"); world w. Descend: for h in (0.12,0.06,0.03,0.015): solve_ik(w+[0,0,h],[0,0,1,0]); move_to_joints. Then open_gripper(); retreat solve_ik(w+[0,0,0.15],[0,0,1,0]).
   Place ON the exact target: pick the deepest valid surface pixel of the target, not a far corner.
5) TURN ON appliance AFTER the object is placed: obs; u,v=point_prompt_molmo(rgb, the control, e.g. "stove knob","burner knob","toaster lever"). world w. Push: for a vertical knob/lever, approach from in front: solve_ik(w+[-0.03,0,0],[0.7071,0,0.7071,0]) move; hold; if a knob, also try w+[-0.03,0,+0.02] and w+[-0.03,0,-0.02]. End with gripper open and >0.25 m away.
Orientation: [0,0,1,0] fingers down; [0.7071,0,0.7071,0] forward; [1,0,0,0] up. solve_ik takes the grasp point between the fingertips (TCP offset applied internally); the returned joints are valid only if within ~0.6-0.8 m of the arm base.
